sentences.text: Montanazhdarcho was a relatively small azhdarchoid pterosaur with a wingspan reaching 2.5 meters.
Its jaws were edentulous, meaning they lacked teeth entirely.
The holotype specimen MOR 691 was found by Robert W. Harmon in Glacier County, Montana, in sandstone of the Upper Two Medicine Formation.
The genus was formally named in 1995 by the same researchers and fully described in 2002.
In 2018, Nicholas Longrich and colleagues recovered Montanazhdarcho within the Azhdarchidae, placing it in the basalmost position.
Montanazhdarcho lived during the Campanian stage, between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago.
